verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents first-party webhooks that push data to any arbitrary external service, using the same triggers as its other notification channels. The destination URL and format (JSON or XML) are customizable, so a programmatic consumer can register an endpoint and receive event callbacks. A first-party Hookdeck guide shows the webhooks in a working integration. Missing for 10: documented payload schemas per event type, evidence of signature verification or retry/delivery guarantees, and independent hands-on corroboration.
